text:
kevin: weird regression: after pulling sdk@1.8.0 our SvelteKit edge endpoint bundle added ~130KB and now throws in worker runtime.

maya: what does the error look like?

kevin: `ReferenceError: process is not defined` coming from a file under node_modules/@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/shims/process.js. analyzer shows large lodash chunk and a crypto shim.

frank: are you importing the package default? SvelteKit adapter builds target edge and esbuild treats CJS wrappers badly.

kevin: code: `import RI from '@redwood-inference/sdk'` in src/routes/api/edge.ts. package.json inside node_modules only has main/module, no exports or sideEffects. root index.js is a tiny CJS proxy.

maya: root CJS proxies kill tree shaking. bundlers will conservatively include interop glue and node-libs. quick local test: `esbuild --bundle src/routes/api/edge.ts --platform=browser` and grep bundle for "process" shows shim.

frank: short-term workarounds for app devs: 1) import explicit ESM build: `import { createClient } from '@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/index.esm.js'` 2) lazy dynamic import inside runtime path 3) pin to 1.7.x.

kevin: tried explicit esm import and that fixes the runtime but is ugly for DX. also typings break for some TS users who expect default export.

maya: SDK tasks: - add conditional exports mapping (import -> dist/index.esm.js, require -> dist/index.cjs.js) - add "sideEffects": false to package.json (with allowlist if needed) - move any top-level `require('node:crypto')` to inside functions (lazy) - ensure types field points to correct .d.ts and default export shape is preserved for TS.

frank: also check published tarball contents: run `npm pack` and inspect. sometimes rollup leaves stray cjs artifacts in root that cause bundlers to resolve to wrong files.

kevin: CI found regression: release-bot flagged +130KB for sveltekit-edge. artifact: https://ci.internal/artifacts/sveltekit/1771001111.html

release-bot: :warning: bundle-regression detected (+130KB). See artifact link.

maya: tests to add in SDK repo: a tiny script that packs the published artifact and runs esbuild/rollup/webpack bundling against a small edge fixture, then assert no node shims and bundle delta <50KB. add this to release checks.

frank: typesync note: if we change exports map, ensure generated .d.ts supports both `import SDK from` and `import { createClient }` to avoid consumers flipping compiler flags. add a TS smoke test too.

kevin: I'll open an issue with analyzer HTML and attach a minimal repro project. tagging @sdk-team and @release.

docs: I'll draft a short devex note and a temporary changelog entry instructing edge/Deno/worker users to use the explicit ESM path until patch release.

kevin: thanks. putting this on the 1.8.1 fixlist. ping me when PR is up. :thumbsup:
